title: Mack Superliner Custom FUPS Road Train Bullbar #9
description: Mack Superliner hi-tensile aluminium FUPS Bullbar. 88mm dia pipe, 100mm dia available. Mesh in front of grille, steel plate over tow hitch painted black or the colour of chassis (as in photo) or chrome, Road Train signs with vinyl covers in silver or to suit chassis (as in photo). Cowcatcher and 4 small uprights no P/L bracket welded on pipe to accommodate no P/L. Driving light mounts as requested, provision for front mudflaps. Full length box uprights for maximum strength. Custom built as required
